title: Extraction Prep for TaqPath Covid-19 Combo Kit
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Arrange samples in tube rack
steps.instruction: Place up to 95 samples (leaving one well for a control) in the tube rack so that they mirror the layout of a 96‑well plate: for slots 1, 4, 7, and 10, fill column 1 from the bottom up, then column 2 (same slots) up to column 5; for slots 2, 5, 8, and 11, fill column 1 from the bottom up to column 3.

steps.title: Load P1000 pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 pipette on the specified mount (left or right) and set the sample tube aspiration height to 1 mm (default) and the dispense height in the plate to 1 mm (default).

steps.title: Pick up tip
steps.instruction: Attach a fresh tip to the P1000 pipette.

steps.title: Aspirate sample
steps.instruction: Aspirate 200 µL of the sample from the tube at the set aspiration height (1 mm).

steps.title: Dispense sample
steps.instruction: Dispense the 200 µL into the deep‑well plate, delivering the volume by column at the set dispense height (1 mm).

steps.title: Drop tip
steps.instruction: Eject the used tip into the waste container.

steps.title: Repeat for all samples
steps.instruction: Repeat the pick‑up tip, aspirate, dispense, and drop tip steps for each sample until the specified number of samples (maximum 95, leaving one control) has been processed.
